task: Historical country reference dates: India, Russia, Iran
method: Normal HTTP retrieval through inherited configured proxy with TLS verification. Source bytes stay temporary; only metadata, hashes, bounded excerpts and findings are retained.
limits: A successful HTTP response is not proof that a historical passage was returned. Reading status is separate.
A SHA256 identifies retrieved bytes; it is not a guarantee of historical truth, permanent availability or independent corroboration.
No full PDF, constitutional translation or copyrighted page artwork is included.
Date-only records have no normalized event instant. Editorial reference cities and IANA zones do not supply historical event times.
